description: Calculates the great-circle distance between two places in kilometres, miles and nautical miles, with the initial and final compass bearings. Each end is one of the website's 20 cities or a latitude and longitude.

from.description: Departure city, one of Anchorage, Auckland, Buenos Aires, Cape Town, Dubai, Johannesburg, Lima, London, Los Angeles, Mexico City, Moscow, Mumbai, Nairobi, New York, Perth, Santiago, São Paulo, Singapore, Sydney or Tokyo. Not needed when fromLatitude and fromLongitude are given.

fromLatitude.description: Departure latitude in degrees, north positive: -90 to 90.

fromLongitude.description: Departure longitude in degrees, east positive: -180 to 180.

to.description: Arrival city, one of Anchorage, Auckland, Buenos Aires, Cape Town, Dubai, Johannesburg, Lima, London, Los Angeles, Mexico City, Moscow, Mumbai, Nairobi, New York, Perth, Santiago, São Paulo, Singapore, Sydney or Tokyo. Not needed when toLatitude and toLongitude are given.

toLatitude.description: Arrival latitude in degrees, north positive: -90 to 90.

toLongitude.description: Arrival longitude in degrees, east positive: -180 to 180.

name: get_flight_distance
title: Flight distance
